title: Validate the exact-price assisted commercial handoff
effort: 0.5–1 day runbook/acceptance; 2–4 days separate sandbox billing integration if chosen
acceptance: New customer explicitly accepts $499 one-time setup + $299/month and “Additional text, email, and AI usage fees may apply.”
Chosen core branches and separately priced Teams/Trajectory/Markets & Makers are documented; premium prices/rates/allowances are approved rather than invented.
Staff can trace request→agreement→billing→approval→first useful task; missing config never falls back to an old tier.
Approved sandbox payment/receipt/activation reconciles failed/retried/abandoned states without duplicate/early grants; existing customer agreements remain unchanged.
limit: Documented Simple offer currently uses assisted activation. No real collection or customer changes are authorized by this audit.

title: Obtain genuine isolated provider acceptance (I2)
acceptance: Dedicated approved merchant/store/mailbox/queue sandbox with no customer data.
Actual signed events, delivery/refund/uncertain/retry outcomes, queue visibility and reconciliation recorded with exact release.
Affected provider/host/collection gates remain off until acceptance; mocked contracts are labeled separately.
limit: Only remaining unknown rubric criterion;3 points uncredited. Synthetic R4 recovery does not prove actual provider acceptance.

title: Verify production-provider backup and operational recovery assurance
effort: 1–2 days once approved redacted/provider backup and isolated target exist
acceptance: Provider/retention/backup identity and intended recovery objectives documented.
Approved copy restored into a separate isolated target, reconciled without touching production.
Recovery ownership, retention and rollback evidence recorded without private payloads/secrets in Git.
limit: Follow-on assurance, not a reopened or strengthened original R4 criterion; fictional rehearsal already satisfies its literal checks.

title: Measure realistic full-page performance and physical-device tasks
effort: 0.5–1.5 days baseline; optimization follows measured cause
acceptance: Preserve the initial 48 diagnostic samples with 132 failed-resource entries, separately from the corrected 48-sample baseline with 48 intentionally blocked analytics requests.
Use the corrected local-image protocol with realistic phone network/CPU/cache conditions; record analytics exclusions explicitly.
Representative physical phone/tablet and keyboard/screen-reader tasks recorded separately.
Define appropriate budgets using actual intended conditions; report failures and min/median/max without user p95 claims.
limit: X3 measurement completeness is not a speed100 claim. Initial WebKit diagnostics omit84 blob images; corrected48 baseline permits them. Historical throttled-mobile speed concern is not disproved.
